newsitem.title: UK: Princess Di's mother banned for drink driving.
newsitem.headline: Princess Di's mother banned for drink driving.

text.p: Princess Diana's mother, Frances Shand Kydd, was found guilty on Friday of drink-driving in Scotland.
Shand Kydd, grandmother to the future king of Britain, was banned from driving for a year and fined 400 pounds ($674).
The 60-year-old grandmother of princes William and Harry had denied driving in Oban, western Scotland, with more than 2-1/2 times the legal limit of alcohol in her blood on April 5.
Policeman Michael Woods had told the court that Shand Kydd mumbled "incoherently" after he stopped her car and was "staggering" when asked to get out.
Shand Kydd refused comment on leaving the Oban courthouse, saying: "I have nothing to say to anybody at any time."
